theorems.name: Submission.scaled_field_deformation_is_admissible
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn N)) (Y : Rn N → Rn N), IsOpen U → ContDiff ℝ 2 Y → HasCompactSupport Y → tsupport Y ⊆ U → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ IsAdmissibleDeformation 2 U (tsupport Y) (fun t x ↦ x + (c * t) • Y x) ∧ ∀ x, initialVelocity (fun t x ↦ x + (c * t) • Y x) x = c • Y x
